name: EKODI Service Truth Policy
principle: Evidence before reasoning. Current EKODI service facts must be verified from authoritative declarations and runtime evidence before an AI or operator asserts them as current truth.

authoritative_sources.deployment_evidence: declared deployWorkflow plus guarded deployment records
authoritative_sources.external_reachability: direct HTTP/DNS verification when authorized and available

rules: Repository code or a repository name proves implementation only; it does not prove deployment or operation.
A successful deployment record does not by itself prove that the canonical public route is operational.
Conversation history, model memory, examples and guessed URL patterns are never authoritative current-state evidence.
Canonical URLs must come from an authoritative EKODI declaration and, when the claim is that the service is currently operational, must also have fresh runtime evidence.
When required runtime evidence is unavailable, return unverified rather than infer a current fact.
Conflicting evidence must be surfaced explicitly and resolved according to EKODI governance precedence rather than silently choosing the most convenient source.
AI providers are consumers of verified EKODI context; they are not the source of truth for EKODI runtime state.

truth_states.declared: An authoritative EKODI source declares the service, route or boundary.
truth_states.implemented: Repository evidence shows an implementation exists.
truth_states.deployed: Guarded deployment evidence indicates a deployment occurred.
truth_states.operational: Declared canonical route and fresh runtime evidence agree that the service is reachable and intended to operate.
truth_states.degraded: The service is intended to operate but current runtime evidence reports degraded behavior.
truth_states.offline: The service is intended to operate but current runtime evidence reports failure.
truth_states.unverified: There is insufficient fresh evidence to assert current runtime state.
truth_states.retired: Governance marks the service or route as no longer current.

ai_behavior.fallback_when_runtime_unavailable: State the declared route or implementation evidence separately and label current operation as unverified.
